summary: This bill requires the Small Business Administration to create an Innovation Voucher Grant Program, which will award grants to small businesses to help them pay for technical assistance and services from research institutions to develop new products and services.

scores.thoughts: This bill establishes a new grant program within the Small Business Administration and authorizes $10 million annually for five fiscal years, directly increasing government spending.
By authorizing new appropriations for a grant program, the bill contributes to increased government spending, which can indirectly impact the national debt by adding to potential deficits.
